questions.knowledge_point: Representing a 2x2 System of Equations Using a Matrix Product
questions.problem:
Represent the following system of equations using matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-y=7 \\ x+y=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
First, notice that both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation, all the variables are on the left-hand side, and all the constants are on the right-hand side.

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-y=7 \\ x+y=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -3\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.problem:
What is the system of equations represented by

$$
[\begin{aligned}8 & -4 \\ -6 & 12\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}16 \\ -18\end{aligned}]?
$$

The corresponding system of equations is

| { | {{field-1}} | $=$ | $\,4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {{field-2}} | $=$ | $\,\,3.$ |  |
questions.worked_solution:
The $2\times 2$ matrix encodes the coefficients of $x$ and $y$, and the $2\times 1$ vector on the right gives the constants, so the system is

$$
{\begin{aligned}8x-4y=16 \\ -6x+12y=-18\end{aligned}
$$

Dividing the first equation by $4$ and the second by $-6$ gives the simplified system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x-y=4 \\ x-2y=3\end{aligned}
$$

which matches the entries shown above.

questions.problem:
What is the system of equations represented by

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ -3 & 12\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -15\end{aligned}]?
$$
questions.worked_solution:
The  $2\times 2$ matrix represents the coefficients of $x$ and $y,$ while the $2\times 1$ column vector on the right-hand side represents the constants of the equations. So, we get the following system of equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}0x-y=0 \\ -3x+12y=-15.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying both equations in the system, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}y=0 \\ x-4y=5.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
